title: Warm Malty Japanese Noodles Ramen Miso
description: A comforting and nourishing Japanese dish featuring malty flavors and bouncy noodles, perfect for a sick day. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe combines palm sugar and temper for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the palm sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add the ramen noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the crumbled tempeh to the pan and cook until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the miso paste and a splash of the hot broth until smooth.
Add the miso mixture to the pot with the noodles and stir to combine.
Add the cooked tempeh and onion mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the ramen hot, garnished with chopped green onion.
